decisionSummary: The three previously reported defects are addressed in the current source snapshot: aliases are queried as exact tuples, canonical order workspace/customer hints are checked before locking, and failed inbox rows can be retried. The review remains blocked because a crash after durable inbox insertion but before reconciliation leaves status=received, and a later verified delivery is still acknowledged as duplicate without retry. The required PostgreSQL regression probe was also unavailable under the current role.
resolvedFindings: BIL-ALIAS-CROSS-PAIR: payment-aliases.ts now queries each exact provider/objectKind/externalId tuple.
BIL-TENANT-HINT-MISMATCH: reconcile-payment.ts now rejects workspace/customer hints that differ from the canonical order before the account lock.
BIL-FAILED-DELIVERY-NO-RETRY: inbox.ts now resets failed rows to received and retries reconciliation on redelivery.

residualFinding.description: A process crash after the inbox insert commits and before reconcilePayment starts leaves status=received. A later verified delivery sees an existing non-failed row and returns duplicate=true, so the durable observation never reaches reconciliation.
residualFinding.requiredEvidence: Use a row lock plus a bounded retry/lease policy for received rows, or explicitly reconcile stale received rows; add a crash-after-receive redelivery probe proving one eventual grant.

blocked: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/probe-billing-reconciliation.ts: PostgreSQL CREATEDB permission denied (42501); prior green-probe evidence predates the current source fixes and does not test the residual crash path.

limits: Local fixture provider only; no Stripe account, live fal request, production billing, production email, paid request, or external network evidence.
This follow-up does not alter task or stage status.
